name: Simple Table
description: A plain table you can type straight into: add rows and columns, Tab and Enter to move around. Type // on an empty line and choose Table, or paste cells copied from Excel or Google Sheets and they become a table. Type // in a cell for a menu: a coloured dropdown like Google Sheets, a link chip (paste a link into a cell with Smart Chips on), a note that opens as a popup (pick one or type a name to create it; it follows the note when it is renamed), today's date, the time, or a checkbox. Stored as an ordinary Markdown table.
tagline: Type // for a table, paste from Excel
author: Granite
